profile.headline: Sr. Embedded System Software Engineer at NVIDIA
profile.summary:
20+ years of experience developing embedded system firmware for Video, Telecom, Network, NAS/SAN, RTOS, and Semiconductor industries.  Experienced in all aspects of product development from system design and development to product release. Proactive in debugging both low-level and high-level software and hardware problems. Having lots of experience to bring up many prototype processor boards from scratch. Mentoring team members for various technical difficulties.  A fast learner with a creative mind.

Specialties:
 - C/C++, Assembly language for most CPU, microcontroller and DSP families.
 - Linux kernel, device driver, volatile target file system, boot sequence.
 - BSP porting and device driver developments for VxWorks, LynxOS, VRTX RTOS
 - board bring up and debugging s/w and h/w mixed bugs.
 - familiar with most industry standard buses and peripherals.
 - Networking, TCP/IP, OSI protocol stacks
 - real-time, multi-thread, fault-tolerant programming
 - managed CVS, VPN, and file servers for the team.
 - version controls and release controls
 - circuit design, FPGA design, PCB artwork
 - hand-on experience with most test equipments

positions.title: Sr. Embedded System Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed and maintained the Linux and QNX display driver for the Tegra SoC family. Brought up Tegra T186 SoC display engine and various control boards with Tegra SoC family for major automotive companies.

positions.title: Staff Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
(Former Motorola Mobility and Motorola Home.)
Developed and maintained the embedded system firmware for the MPEG4/AVC SD/HD video encoder, SE-5000, SE-6000, ST-6000, product lines. Performed bringing up H/W modules, porting Linux kernels, developing device drivers, target file systems, packaging and releasing versions.  Managed CVS and build servers for the team.

positions.title: Staff Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
(Former Motorola Inc. and Modulus Video.)
Developed and maintained the embedded system firmware for the MPEG4/AVC SD/HD video encoder, SE-5000, SE-6000, ST-6000, product lines. Performed bringing up H/W modules, porting Linux kernels, developing device drivers, target file systems, packaging and releasing versions. Managed CVS and build servers for the team.
Participated in new H/W bring-up, Linux Kernel and driver porting, and target run environment modification for the industry first real time 1RU HEVC encoder demonstration in the NAB 2013.

positions.title: Staff Engineer
positions.description: Developed and maintained the embedded system firmware for the MPEG4/AVC SD/HD video encoder product lines. Performed bringing up H/W modules, porting Linux kernels, developing device drivers, target file systems, packaging and releasing versions.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed and maintained the embedded system firmware for the VOD Server and the high bandwidth SAN accelerator consisted of 72ea Intel Xscale processors, up to 36ea Gigabit Ethernet and Fibre Channels and 4ea 2T RAM cache cards.  Performed bringing up of CPU boards including 8ea Intel Xscale processors, 2 or 4ea Gigabit Ethernet or Fibre Channels, PCI, and I2C bus devices.  Ported Linux 2.4 kernels, developed BSP, boot loader over PCI bus and various device drivers. Managed CVS, VPN, and file servers for the team.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed firmware for a high-performance, low-cost single box internet appliance for small to medium size networks. System incorporated router, firewall, NAT, DHCP, file server, VPN, WiFi, 802.1x, and WAN failover.  Performed development of Hifn 7951 Encryption chip driver and modified TCP/IP stack to accelerate IPSec, PPTP, L2TP VPN throughput with hardware encryptions.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
(Former Integrated Software & Device Corperation.)
Involved every aspect of embedded system software / firmware development to provide outsourcing service to major companies such as HP, Sun, Lucent, Cirrus Logic.  Launched industry first embedded  Linux distribution for ARM, Royal Linux.

positions.title: Sr. Control System Engineer
positions.description: Designed and developed embedded real-time machine control systems for semiconductor production equipment.

positions.title: Sr. Engineer
positions.description: Designed and developed system control software and firmware for PSTN, ISDN, PCM, SONET/SDH, ATM telecom equipments. Managed and led software and hardware developments for the SMOT-4 project and was honored with IR-52 Jang-Young-Sil prize by the Korean government.
